Title: Fix `Approve all` batch semantics to be per-item (for example 3/5 valid applies 3), report itemized outcomes (`approved`/`rejected`/`blocked`/`failed`), and clear/refresh pending cards and counters deterministically.
Description:
Problem: the original batch approval flow was fail-fast and hard to audit. Recent work improved per-item handling, but deterministic pending-state cleanup and outcome coverage still need hardening.

Desired outcome:
- Batch approval applies valid items independently and records explicit per-item outcomes.
- Remaining reconciliation logic leaves no orphaned pending cards or ambiguous counts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Mixed batches report `approved`, `rejected`, `blocked`, or `failed` per item.
- Valid proposals in a mixed batch continue independently instead of being cancelled by one bad item.
- Pending UI state is consistent after the batch completes.

Validation:
- Re-run the mixed-batch scenario from the chat-agent testing tracker.
- Add focused test coverage for per-item outcomes and post-batch state reconciliation.

Audit note: vetted on 2026-05-24; narrowed but not fully obsolete because logs show per-item behavior improved while state reconciliation remains incomplete.
